Head_and_Face: Bill is short, thick, and conical with a sharp tip, grey in winter and black in breeding season.
Eyes are dark and round, positioned laterally.
Breeding male has a black head and throat.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact and rounded.
Breeding male has bright orange-rufous breast and underparts with black upperparts and bold white shoulder patches and rump.
Female and non-breeding male exhibit duller brownish-grey upperparts with buff-orange underparts.
Plumage texture is soft and slightly fluffy with a matte finish.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are moderately long with pointed primaries.
Flight displays distinctive white wing bars and white outer tail feathers.
Legs are pinkish-brown with slender toes and small claws adapted for perching.

Head_and_Face: Bright crimson-red face mask covers the forehead, throat, and cheeks, sharply demarcated from surrounding plumage.
Bill is short, conical, and pale yellow-grey.
Eyes are dark and positioned laterally.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact.
Upperparts are warm brown with a buff rump; underparts are pale buff to white.
Sexual dimorphism is moderate; females exhibit a duller face mask (orange-brown rather than crimson).
Plumage texture is soft and finely textured.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are black with a broad, vivid yellow median wing bar and white primary patches.
Tail is forked with black rectrices and white outer edges.
Legs are pinkish-brown with slender toes.

Head_and_Face: Bill is short, conical, and greyish.
Eyes are dark and round.
Breeding male exhibits vivid red to orange-red coloration on the head.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact with moderately notched tail.
Breeding male has red to orange-red breast and rump with brown streaked upperparts and flanks.
Female and juvenile plumage is entirely brown with heavy dark streaking on breast and flanks.
Plumage texture is soft with a slightly streaked appearance on the back and flanks.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are moderately long with two pale wing bars visible against brown background.
Tail is moderately forked with brown rectrices.
Legs are pinkish-brown with slender toes.

Head_and_Face: Bill is short, conical, and pale pinkish-grey.
Eyes are dark with a distinctive white eye-ring in some subspecies.
Slate-grey to black head, throat, and breast (hood) sharply demarcated from white belly.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact and rounded.
Back is brown or grey.
Outer tail feathers are pure white, creating a conspicuous flashing pattern in flight.
Plumage texture is soft and slightly fluffy.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are moderately long with two pale wing bars on dark brown wings.
Tail is moderately long and squared with white outer rectrices.
Legs are pinkish with slender toes.

Head_and_Face: Bill is short, thick, and conical, grey in breeding season and pale in winter.
Eyes are dark and round.
Female has a pale supercilium (eyebrow stripe) and darker eye-line.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact.
Breeding male exhibits uniform, vivid indigo-blue plumage with blackish wings and tail; appears nearly black in low light but displays brilliant blue iridescence in direct sunlight.
Female and non-breeding male are entirely warm brown with faint darker streaking on the breast and buff-colored wing bars.
Male plumage texture is smooth and tightly appressed with a glossy, metallic sheen.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are moderately long with rounded primaries.
Tail is moderately long and slightly notched.
Legs are pinkish-brown with slender toes.

Head_and_Face: Head is dark grey to blackish with a broken white eye-ring and white throat streaked with dark markings.
Bill is yellow with a dark tip, moderately long and straight.
Eyes are dark and round with a prominent white eye-ring.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust.
Breast and upper abdomen are uniformly bright rust-red to orange-red, sharply demarcated from the grey-brown back and wings.
Wings are dark brown with no distinctive markings; tail is dark with white outer corners visible in flight.
Plumage texture is soft and slightly fluffy on the breast, with smoother feathers on the back.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and yellowish-brown with sturdy toes adapted for ground foraging.
Tail is dark with white outer corners visible in flight.

Head_and_Face: Many species exhibit a prominent crest of elongated feathers on the crown.
Bill is short, slender, and slightly decurved, dark in coloration.
Eyes are dark with a prominent white or yellow eye-ring in many species.
Some species have bare facial skin patches in bright colors (red, yellow, or blue).
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender.
Upperparts are typically olive-brown to grey-brown with pale yellow to white underparts.
Some species exhibit bright yellow vent or red facial patches.
Plumage texture is soft and slightly loose with a matte finish.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are moderately long with rounded primaries.
Tail is moderately long and squared or slightly graduated.
Legs are slender and dark with thin toes adapted for arboreal perching.

Head_and_Face: Prominent erectile crest on the crown composed of elongated, pointed feathers that can be raised or lowered.
Bill is stout, slightly curved, and black.
Eyes are dark with a pale eye-ring.
Crest displays blue and black barring when erect.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust.
Plumage is predominantly blue-grey on upperparts with a distinctive black necklace across the throat and upper breast.
Underparts are pale grey to white.
Plumage texture is smooth and glossy with a slight iridescent sheen on blue feathers.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings display vivid blue, black, and white barring patterns with a bright blue patch on the primary coverts.
Tail is long and graduated with blue and black banding.
Legs are dark grey with sturdy toes and strong claws.

Head_and_Face: Head, neck, and breast are glossy black with a metallic green and purple iridescent sheen.
Bill is stout, black, and slightly curved with a sharp tip.
Eyes are dark.
Body_and_Plumage: Body exhibits striking black-and-white plumage pattern.
Shoulders, belly, and wing patches are pure white, creating a sharply contrasting bicolor pattern.
Back is glossy black.
Plumage texture is smooth and glossy with a highly reflective iridescent finish on black feathers.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is exceptionally long (20-30 cm), graduated with black central rectrices and white outer feathers.
Wings are broad with white primary coverts forming a conspicuous patch in flight.
Legs are black with sturdy toes and strong claws.

Head_and_Face: Black cap and black throat (bib) sharply demarcated from white cheeks, creating a bold facial pattern.
Bill is very short, stubby, and black.
Eyes are dark and round, positioned within the white cheek patch.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, rounded with short neck.
Upperparts are grey-blue to grey-brown; underparts are white to buff with grey flanks.
Plumage texture is soft and fluffy.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are short and rounded with grey-brown plumage and pale edges on the coverts creating subtle wing bars.
Tail is short and slightly notched with grey-brown rectrices.
Legs are thin and dark with small toes.
